# 紧的三个等价刻画　`thm.metric-compact-equiv`　·　续页（第 2 页）
[在星图里打开](../#n=thm.metric-compact-equiv)　·　第 1 页 [nodes/thm.metric-compact-equiv.md](./thm.metric-compact-equiv.md)

## English abstract · **draft** · machine-drafted, pending author review; Chinese is authoritative（续）
In a metric space the following are equivalent: compact, sequentially compact, and complete together with totally bounded. The skeleton lives in the implications: compact implies sequentially compact; sequentially compact implies totally bounded (the one place dependent choice is used) and complete; sequentially compact implies compact by the "bad ball" argument; complete and totally bounded implies sequentially compact by diagonalisation. In general topological spaces only the first implication survives — sequential compactnes
s is a metric-space luxury.
